caption: The drawing depicts a wooden bucket with a slightly conical shape, wider at the base and narrower at the top. The bucket is constructed from several vertical wooden planks bound together with two horizontal wooden bands, one near the bottom and one around the upper edge. There are visible round rivets or fasteners on the bands. The color of the bucket is light brown with darker brown shading and wood grain patterns, giving it a natural wood appearance. The bucket has a thick, curved wooden handle, attached at two points on opposite sides of the upper band. The handle arches above the top opening. The bucket also features a round, flat wooden lid that rests at an angle on the rim, partially open. The background is a plain, pale beige color with no other objects present. The artist's signature "Chris Makrenos" is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Maple Sugar Bucket
